name: q2m-lint
description: ESLint for the Q2M site. Separate install because the site builds with TypeScript 7 (native, no JS API yet) while ESLint's TypeScript parser needs TypeScript 5.x. Run from the repo root: npm run lint
_overridesNote: typescript-eslint's parser asks for minimatch 10.x, which has a moderate advisory (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249); it gets 11.x (same named API). Other packages keep their own minimatch.
